title: Looking For Online ESL Teachers - Remote- Joining Rewards of up to USD $100
description:

We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between August 14 and September 30.

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $50

Option 2 — Earn $100

  • Have no no-shows.

⏳ Please complete your application within the next 2 days to meet the high demand for bookings.

Technical Requirements

Availability

Given your extensive teaching background, we believe Polly English would be an excellent fit for your skills and expertise. We look forward to the possibility of you joining our team and making a meaningful impact together.

If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com.

title: Virtual Bookkeeper
description:
About Strong Roots Accounting

Strong Roots Accounting is a small accounting firm based in Fort Worth, Texas, serving small businesses and nonprofits with accurate, reliable bookkeeping and financial insight. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month.

We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. Our vision is bigger than bookkeeping: we are building something that creates meaningful opportunities for people to build long-lasting stability and confidence in their future.

We are growing — intentionally and carefully — and we are looking for the right person to grow with us.

This Is Who We Are

We operate by a set of values and principles that are non-negotiable. They are not posted on a wall and forgotten. They are how we show up every day.

Core Values:

  • Trust

  • Quality

  • Contribution

Our Principles:

  • Honesty and accuracy above all.

  • Be curious. Ask why. And solve problems.

  • Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication.

  • Repeatable processes are the only option.

If you read those and felt something — keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay.

This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For

We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following:

  • People who cut corners and hope no one notices

  • People who go quiet when things get hard

  • People who need to be micromanaged to deliver

  • People who treat accuracy as optional

  • People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do

  • People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers

If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well — just not here.

The Role

The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job.

Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day — there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder — we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track.

Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together.

This is a remote, backend bookkeeping position supporting our Client Relationship Manager. You will not have direct contact with clients — your job is to execute the bookkeeping work accurately, quietly, and on time so our team can deliver a seamless experience on the client-facing side.

You will manage end-of-month reconciliations across approximately 30 small business and nonprofit client accounts. Work is assigned by our Client Relationship Manager, who will be your primary point of contact for priorities, questions, and feedback.

This role may be part-time or full-time — we are open to the right fit and will discuss arrangements with the right candidate.

What You Will Do

  • Perform end-of-month bank reconciliations across a portfolio of small business and nonprofit clients

  • Categorize and organize transactions accurately within QuickBooks Online

  • Ensure client books are clean, consistent, and completed on time every month

  • Flag discrepancies or unusual items to the Client Relationship Manager for review

  • Follow established processes and SOPs for each client account

  • Maintain accuracy and confidentiality across all client files at all times

What We Are Looking For

Required:

  • Minimum 2 years of bookkeeping experience, preferably with U.S.-based clients

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online — this is non-negotiable

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets

  • Familiarity with Xero is a plus

  • Strong written and spoken English — you will communicate regularly with our team

  • High attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to accuracy

  • Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, professional remote work setup

  • Ability to work during U.S. Central Standard Time hours or with meaningful overlap

  • Self-directed — you manage your workload, you meet your deadlines, you ask when you are unsure

Nice to have:

  • Experience with nonprofit accounting

  • Prior experience working remotely with U.S.-based accounting firms

  • Familiarity with bookkeeping across multiple industries

How to Apply

If you read this entire posting and felt like it described the kind of team you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

Email katelynn@strongrootsaccounting.com with the subject line "ROOTS" and include:

1.  A brief introduction — who you are, your bookkeeping experience, and the types of clients you have worked with

2.  Your resume or CV

3.  Two or three sentences in English telling us what honesty and accuracy mean to you in your work

4.  Your availability and whether you are interested in part-time or full-time work

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. This is the first test.
